summary: Doctor's plugin check passes with the --plugin-dir hint when no vloop plugin is installed, warns 'installed but disabled — claude plugin enable vloop@vloop' for a disabled one, and warns with the stderr/exit/parse error when claude plugin list fails. An enabled plugin of the binary's version passes; another version keeps its mismatch warning.
